period_note: STANDALONE/SOLO basis used per project convention (matches this bank's primary Q4/annual series); filing presents both a Condensed CONSOLIDATED statement set (pp.2-4) and a full Condensed [Solo/Standalone] statement set (pp.7-9), as usual for this bank. Income-statement line items are the 'Cumulative Jan to Sep 2018' column (the filing also separately discloses a discrete 'Quarter ended July to Sep 2018' Standalone column: interest income 6,330,482,825; PAT 1,365,497,219; EPS 1.27 — not recorded as line items here, kept for a possible future finer-grained pass). This quarter's Solo balance sheet introduces a new small equity line, 'Translation reserve' (BDT 1.18m, presumably FX translation on the Off-shore Banking Unit, which per the filing's own note 2.4 is reported within the Solo financial statements) — recorded here as 'translation_reserve'; this line was not present in the 2018 Q1/Q2 Solo statements for this bank. Balance sheet identity reconciles exactly in raw Taka: 266,972,432,999 (total liabilities) + 30,094,248,130 (total equity) = 297,066,681,129 (total assets); independent BDT-million rounding of each line can shift the displayed totals by ±1 BDT million (e.g. total assets displays as 297,067m while liabilities 266,972m + equity 30,094m = 297,066m) — immaterial, not a data error. Reported equity sub-components (paid-up capital + share premium + statutory reserve + dividend equalization fund + revaluation reserve on govt securities + assets revaluation reserve + translation reserve + retained earnings) sum exactly to total shareholders' equity in raw Taka. Every P&L subtotal reconciles exactly in raw Taka. NAV/CRAR/ROA/ROE/AD-ratio sourced from Note 6 'Performance Highlights' (Standalone basis, 30 September 2018); ROA/ROE explicitly labelled 'annualized' by the bank. Parallel Consolidated-basis comparators (not used, given for reference): total assets 332,182m, total equity incl. NCI 37,191m, NAV/share 30.26, EPS_cumulative 3.55, CRAR 14.78%, ROA* 1.59%, ROE* 17.20%.

Parallel Condensed CONSOLIDATED Balance Sheet/P&L also present on pp.2-4 (not used, per project convention of preferring Solo/Standalone when both are present in the filing).
